material.hachilite.head: Hachilite Head
material.sakalti.soralite.armor: A sky-blue alloy with gradual self-repair.
material.sakalti.soralite.encyclopedia: Slowly repairs itself after use, even when no longer held.
material.sakalti.soralite.ranged: A sky-blue alloy with gradual self-repair.
modifier.sakalti.auro_stone.flavor: See everything. Miss nothing. Still can't see your taxes.
modifier.sakalti.auro_vision.description: Glows targets on attack and grants permanent Night Vision to the user.
modifier.sakalti.auro_vision.flavor: Night Vision included. Sleep schedule not included.
modifier.sakalti.berserk.description: Consumes extra durability... Ahhh, growing stronger!
modifier.sakalti.berserk.flavor: Durability is temporary. Bonk is forever.
modifier.sakalti.celestite_resonance.des: Increases attack damage based on the target's remaining health and triggers Celestite Resonance on hit.
modifier.sakalti.celestite_resonance.fla: The lower their health gets, the more dramatic the math becomes.
modifier.sakalti.chirite.flavor: Hit them once. Congratulations, they're a walking lamp.
modifier.sakalti.coralian.description: Grants the Coralian effect when its conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.coralian.flavor: The coral has standards. Meet them or don't.
modifier.sakalti.fieldy.description: Grants a brief invulnerability barrier when attacking.
modifier.sakalti.fire_wall.description: Deals around 1 damage across a wide area.
modifier.sakalti.fire_wall.flavor: A wall of fire: because doors were apparently too normal.
modifier.sakalti.glacial_bind.descriptio: Slowness is applied to targets on attack.
modifier.sakalti.glacial_bind.flavor: Your enemy's legs have officially filed a complaint.
modifier.sakalti.gradually.description: Mining blocks permanently builds progress; each level adds 0.35 mining speed.
modifier.sakalti.heavy_stone.description: Grants Resistance III, but renders you nearly immobile.
modifier.sakalti.heavy_stone.flavor: Resistance III, mobility III... actually, mobility is zero.
modifier.sakalti.ice_bind.description: Summons spikes spaced every 2m in the attack direction.
modifier.sakalti.ice_bind.flavor: The floor is now spikes. Sorry about that.
modifier.sakalti.itsulic_nihilism.descri: Accumulates an attack damage bonus from defeated enemies based on their maximum health.
modifier.sakalti.itsulic_nihilism.flavor: Every defeat adds to the ledger. The ledger is getting personal.
modifier.sakalti.jumpy.flavor: Gravity called. You put it on hold.
modifier.sakalti.laser_prism.description: Fires a damaging laser effect when its conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.laser_prism.flavor: Point at target. Press bonk. Become a laser engineer.
modifier.sakalti.lifesteal.description: Restores a portion of damage dealt as health on attack.
modifier.sakalti.lifesteal.flavor: Why carry a potion when the enemy is already full of health?
modifier.sakalti.light_touch.flavor: A light touch. The target will disagree.
modifier.sakalti.long_spark.description: Summons spikes spaced every 2m up to 10m in the attack direction; deals higher damage the further away.
modifier.sakalti.long_spark.flavor: Why use one spike when ten meters of spikes will do?
modifier.sakalti.lucky.description: Periodically restores the tool to full durability at a random interval of 1 second to 6 minutes.
modifier.sakalti.lucky.flavor: Sometimes the tool repairs itself. Sometimes you just stare at it.
modifier.sakalti.lure_meteor.description: Calls down a meteor effect on hit, dealing armor-piercing additional damage.
modifier.sakalti.lure_meteor.flavor: Subtlety has left the server. A meteor is incoming.
modifier.sakalti.poisonous_bind.flavor: Because regular damage apparently wasn't rude enough.
modifier.sakalti.saturation.description: While a tool with Hotalite is selected, restores hunger every 20 ticks. Higher levels restore more hunger.
modifier.sakalti.saturation.flavor: Hunger? What hunger? Hotalite says no.
modifier.sakalti.seiren_curse.descriptio: A terrible curse takes hold... AAAAAHHHHHHH!
modifier.sakalti.seiren_curse.flavor: Congratulations! You have unlocked the screaming department.
modifier.sakalti.slowrepair.description: Slowly repairs a damaged tool over time, even when the tool is no longer held.
modifier.sakalti.slowrepair.flavor: Slow and steady wins the repair race... eventually.
modifier.sakalti.super_magnet.flavor: Items now come to you. Your inventory still says no.
modifier.sakalti.supermagnet.flavor: Drop an item and pretend it was planned.
modifier.sakalti.unstable.flavor: Results may vary. Physics has been notified.
modifier.sakalti.weak_burn.description: Weakness is applied to targets on attack.
modifier.sakalti.weak_burn.flavor: It's not a campfire. It's just disappointed in you.
modifier.sakalti.scorch.description: Sets hit living targets on fire for 4 seconds plus 2 seconds per modifier level.
modifier.sakalti.scorch.flavor: A little warmth. The target did not ask for a sauna.
modifier.sakalti.blast.description: On melee hit, has a 20% chance to create a power-1.5 explosion at the target that does not damage blocks.
modifier.sakalti.blast.flavor: A 20% chance to turn a hit into a very loud punctuation mark.
material.sakalti.sulphur.encyclopedia: A modest material with scorch and blast properties.
modifier.sakalti.hacilite_modifier.descr: 5% chance to slow enemies on hit.
modifier.sakalti.soul_eater.description: Defeating enemies with this tool permanently grants a small damage bonus.
modifier.sakalti.crawling.description: While active, forces the player into a low crawling posture and applies the associated movement effects.
modifier.sakalti.crawling.flavor: You wanted to sneak. The floor took that as a formal invitation.
modifier.sakalti.survive.description: Prevents a lethal hit once its conditions are met, restores a small amount of health, and grants temporary defensive effects.
modifier.sakalti.survive.flavor: Death filed a complaint. This modifier sent it back unread.
modifier.sakalti.astral_aegis.descriptio: Reduces incoming damage and retaliates against nearby attackers with magic damage.
modifier.sakalti.astral_aegis.flavor: A celestial shield with a very earthly grudge.
modifier.sakalti.laserprism_guard.descri: Uses the Laser Prism guard effect to protect its wearer when its defensive trigger activates.
modifier.sakalti.laserprism_guard.flavor: The safest place near a laser is apparently behind another laser.
modifier.sakalti.tough.description: Increases the wearer’s defensive attributes while the modifier is active.
modifier.sakalti.tough.flavor: Built like a fortress. Still complains about paper cuts.
modifier.sakalti.magnetic_field.descript: Creates a magnetic field that detects incoming projectiles and redirects them away from the wearer.
modifier.sakalti.magnetic_field.flavor: Your personal space now has a force field. Please respect it.
modifier.sakalti.longspark_guard.descrip: Activates the Long Spark defensive effect when its guard conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.longspark_guard.flavor: A pointy answer to an even pointier problem.
modifier.sakalti.star_connect.descriptio: Applies its star-linked defensive effect when the modifier conditions are satisfied.
modifier.sakalti.star_connect.flavor: The stars aligned. Your enemies should have stayed home.
modifier.sakalti.abyssal_requiem.descrip: Restores health based on a defeated target’s maximum health and grants a temporary beneficial effect.
modifier.sakalti.abyssal_requiem.flavor: The abyss called. It wants its health bar back.
modifier.sakalti.cryofreeze.description: At low health, suppresses freezing buildup, gradually heals the wearer, and applies cold-related effects to nearby combatants.
modifier.sakalti.cryofreeze.flavor: When life gets heated, become the freezer.
modifier.sakalti.superblast.description: Triggers the enhanced blast effect when its activation conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.superblast.flavor: Regular explosions were apparently too polite.
modifier.sakalti.gravitas.flavor: Gravity still works. It is simply less persuasive.
modifier.sakalti.inferno.description: Applies the Inferno effect when its activation conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.inferno.flavor: A little inferno. A rather large insurance claim.
modifier.sakalti.crystallize.description: At critical health, consumes tool durability to activate a temporary protective crystal effect that can block incoming damage.
modifier.sakalti.crystallize.flavor: Turning panic into crystals is a perfectly valid strategy.
modifier.sakalti.reduce.description: Reduces incoming damage by the amount defined by this modifier.
modifier.sakalti.reduce.flavor: Damage has been asked to lower its expectations.
modifier.sakalti.super_reduce.descriptio: Provides a stronger reduction to incoming damage than the standard Reduce modifier.
modifier.sakalti.super_reduce.flavor: Damage reduction, now with extra reduction.
modifier.sakalti.incendium.description: Applies the Incendium effect when its activation conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.incendium.flavor: The temperature is not a suggestion.
modifier.sakalti.crimson_thorns.descript: Reduces incoming damage and reflects a portion of eligible damage back at the attacker.
modifier.sakalti.crimson_thorns.flavor: Please do not hug the armor.
modifier.sakalti.heavy.description: Increases downward acceleration while active, making movement and jumps feel heavier.
modifier.sakalti.heavy.flavor: Gravity has enabled the premium subscription.
modifier.sakalti.ice_thorns.description: Uses the Ice Thorns defensive effect when its trigger conditions are met.
modifier.sakalti.ice_thorns.flavor: Cold shoulder? Try the entire frozen hedge.
gamerule.sakaltiRemoveCreepers.descripti: Whether creepers are removed from the world.
modifier.sakalti.vitality.description: Periodically grants a beneficial vitality effect while the item is active in the required slot.
modifier.sakalti.vitality.flavor: A little vitality goes a long way. Usually.
modifier.sakalti.soul_eater.flavor: Every defeated foe leaves a little strength behind. The tool keeps receipts.
modifier.sakalti.gradually.flavor: One block at a time. Your mining speed is learning patience.
